# Row V1. beehest serve hosts the engine, a run joins it, and serve stops by SIGINT while the joined run waits. The joined run is not cancelled: it takes over and finishes after its answer.
isolate
! exec bd version
! exec gh version

example review-loop/project.star config/projects/orders.star
exec beehestreal item add orders base-1 --title 'Base' --body-file body.txt

exec beehestreal serve &serve&
waitstatus 'engine: serve, pid'
exec beehestreal run base-1 orders --workflow flow/wait.star &base&
waitstatus 'question of base-1'
kill -INT serve
wait serve
exec beehestreal answer base-1 done
wait base
stdout 'item base-1 finished'

-- body.txt --
Wait.
-- flow/wait.star --
def main(item):
    wait(name = "close", question = "question of " + item.id)
